rule: S_N must not be null

rule: S_N must be unique across the table
rationale: Evidence indicates this is a one-to-one key with Cust_Bio_dirty, yet the sample shows value '3' appearing twice, violating uniqueness.

rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one join key with Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N; referential integrity must be enforced.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a business identifier with 0 missing values in the sample and must remain populated.

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full_Name is a mandatory demographic field with 0 missing values observed.

rule: Full_Name must follow Title Case convention (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Sample contains lowercase entries ('junrong', 'irfan') and lowercase surname components ('Lee yixuan', 'Hui Min tan') that deviate from the dominant Title Case pattern.

check_params.logic: pd.notna(row['Full_Name']) and any((w[0].islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace (double spaces)
rationale: Sample record 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' contains double spacing between particles and names.

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is a mandatory identifier (Singapore NRIC/FIN) with 0 missing values.

rule: ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow this format; sample contains malformed value 'S123456' with only 6 digits and no checksum letter.

rule: JoinDate must not be null

rule: JoinDate must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: Sample contains unparseable value '2025-13-01' with invalid month 13.

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate is a historical field (account creation); sample contains future date '2027-01-15'.

rule: LastLogin must be parseable as a valid datetime
rationale: LastLogin is stored as string and intended as datetime; all sample values use consistent format but parseability must be enforced.

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Business logic requires account creation to precede or equal the last login timestamp; sample shows JoinDate '2020-11-02' after LastLogin '2019-01-01'.

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Subscription_Type is a mandatory categorical field with 0 missing values.

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of the allowed values: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Evidence shows exactly 5 distinct subscription tiers; values outside this set indicate data corruption.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: SubscriptionFee has 2 observed NULL values (6.7%) in a financial field that should be populated (even if zero).

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Column is intended as float64 but stored as string; sample contains non-numeric value 'free'.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel value 99999
rationale: Value '99999' appears in the sample and is flagged as a statistical outlier likely representing missing/invalid data.

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary charges and should not be negative; validates after numeric parsing.

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or null
rationale: Business logic dictates that Free subscriptions carry no fee; sample shows multiple Free accounts with positive fees (e.g., 917.46, 540.3).

check_params.logic: pd.notna(row['Subscription_Type']) and row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.notna(pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce')) and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') > 0
